name: West Bengal
tagline: A major eastern Indian state with Kolkata as its principal metropolitan centre.
description: West Bengal is one of eastern India's largest urban and economic markets, anchored by Kolkata and its wider metropolitan region. Its property landscape combines established neighbourhoods, planned townships, business districts, suburban growth corridors and emerging residential markets. For Great Homes, West Bengal is the top-level geographic node from which city and locality discovery can be organised.

name: Kolkata
tagline: A mature metropolitan housing market spanning established neighbourhoods and fast-growing eastern corridors.
description: Kolkata is West Bengal's principal metropolitan market and a major centre for residential, commercial, education, healthcare and culture. The city combines historic central and north Kolkata neighbourhoods with established southern districts and the fast-developing eastern belt around Salt Lake, Rajarhat and New Town. Great Homes can use Kolkata as the primary city node for project discovery, resale, rental and location-led property research.
coordinateCmsNote: City coordinates are representative city-centre coordinates.

name: New Town
tagline: A planned, rapidly expanding township with major residential, business and lifestyle districts.
description: New Town is a planned satellite city on Kolkata's north-eastern edge, organised into three major Action Areas with a central business district. The market blends large residential projects, IT/ITeS campuses, retail destinations, open spaces and new infrastructure. Great Homes should treat New Town as a primary project discovery market with deep neighbourhood-level granularity.

name: Rajarhat
tagline: A major eastern growth corridor connecting mature Kolkata districts with New Town.
description: Rajarhat is a large eastern Kolkata growth belt with a mix of established settlements, gated housing, apartment developments, local markets and newer urban infrastructure. Its proximity to New Town, the airport corridor and major arterial roads makes it an important residential search market. Great Homes can use Rajarhat as a broad locality node and attach more precise neighbourhoods below it.

name: Salt Lake
tagline: Kolkata's established planned township and a major residential, institutional and business market.
description: Salt Lake, the original township of Bidhannagar, is a mature planned urban market with established residential sectors, institutions, retail nodes and the Sector V technology district. The area's stable infrastructure and access to central Kolkata make it a core residential and rental market. It should remain one of Great Homes' primary location nodes.

name: Dum Dum
tagline: A dense northern gateway linking central Kolkata, the airport corridor and suburban markets.
description: Dum Dum is a strategically located northern market close to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport and major road and rail connections. Housing ranges from established apartment neighbourhoods to compact residential pockets and older communities. Its connectivity makes it useful for both end-user and rental discovery.

name: Lake Town
tagline: A well-connected residential district between Salt Lake, VIP Road and central Kolkata.
description: Lake Town is an established residential area positioned between Salt Lake and the airport-side corridor. It benefits from access to VIP Road, Jessore Road and nearby commercial and retail destinations, with a predominantly apartment-led housing market. The location works well as a standalone residential search page under Kolkata.

name: Baguiati
tagline: A busy north-eastern residential corridor close to VIP Road, the airport and Rajarhat.
description: Baguiati is an established mixed residential and local-commerce district along the airport-side eastern corridor. Its housing stock includes apartments, independent homes and smaller redevelopment opportunities, while nearby arterial roads support daily commuting. Great Homes can position it as a practical connectivity-led residential market.

name: Keshtopur
tagline: A dense eastern residential belt connecting Salt Lake, New Town and north-east Kolkata.
description: Keshtopur sits along the eastern urban fringe between Salt Lake and New Town and is known for dense residential development with strong road connectivity. The area combines apartment communities, local markets and older settlements with expanding access to New Town. It is a useful value-oriented search location for buyers and renters.

name: North Kolkata
tagline: Historic Kolkata neighbourhoods with enduring residential character and strong urban connectivity.
description: North Kolkata contains some of the city's oldest and most recognisable neighbourhoods, including Shyambazar, Shobhabazar, Bagbazar, Jorasanko, Chitpur and Maniktala. The housing landscape spans heritage properties, older apartment stock, redevelopment sites and established local communities. Great Homes can use North Kolkata as an editorial regional node with detailed neighbourhood pages beneath it.

name: Central Kolkata
tagline: The historic civic and commercial core surrounded by established residential and lifestyle districts.
description: Central Kolkata contains the city's principal government, financial, institutional, retail and office districts, including B. B. D. Bagh, Esplanade, Bowbazar and the Park Street business belt. Residential demand is closely connected to employment, education, healthcare, retail and cultural infrastructure. For Great Homes, it is a high-authority location cluster linking central business and residential search.

name: Park Street
tagline: A premium central district known for offices, hospitality, dining, retail and established residences.
description: Park Street is one of central Kolkata's best-known commercial and lifestyle addresses, surrounded by offices, hotels, restaurants, institutions and well-established residential pockets. Property demand is typically driven by central employment, connectivity and the prestige of the address. Great Homes can use it as a premium locality page with adjacent streets and neighbourhoods beneath it.

name: Ballygunge
tagline: A prime south Kolkata residential district with established apartment and luxury housing stock.
description: Ballygunge is one of Kolkata's best-known residential districts, with a mature mix of premium apartments, independent homes, schools, healthcare and lifestyle destinations. Its central-south location provides access to Park Street, Gariahat and major arterial roads. It is a core premium residential market for Great Homes.

name: Gariahat
tagline: A prominent south Kolkata retail and residential address centred on a major urban corridor.
description: Gariahat is a high-activity mixed residential and retail district in south Kolkata. The market benefits from dense local commerce, established apartment communities and quick access to Ballygunge, Dhakuria, Jadavpur and central Kolkata. Great Homes can use Gariahat as both a residential destination and a location-intent SEO node.

name: Bhowanipore
tagline: A central-south Kolkata neighbourhood with strong connectivity and mature residential infrastructure.
description: Bhowanipore is a long-established residential district south of the Maidan and close to major hospitals, schools, transport links and commercial streets. Its housing stock includes older homes, apartments and redevelopment opportunities, with convenient access to central Kolkata and Alipore. It remains a strong end-user and established-family residential market.

name: Alipore
tagline: An established premium south Kolkata address known for large homes, apartments and institutional landmarks.
description: Alipore is one of Kolkata's most established premium residential districts, characterised by spacious properties, apartment developments, institutional uses and access to major city roads. Its proximity to Bhowanipore, New Alipore, central Kolkata and the city's major cultural and civic destinations reinforces its premium positioning. Great Homes can treat Alipore as a flagship locality.

name: New Alipore
tagline: A planned south-west Kolkata residential district with broad roads and established apartment communities.
description: New Alipore is a planned residential neighbourhood with mature apartment communities, local markets, schools and strong road connectivity toward Alipore, Behala and central Kolkata. Its housing market combines established apartments with redevelopment and resale opportunities. The locality is well suited to project, resale and family-home discovery.

name: Jadavpur
tagline: A large south Kolkata education and residential market with deep neighbourhood connectivity.
description: Jadavpur is a major south Kolkata locality anchored by educational institutions, established residential pockets and a broad network of local markets and arterial roads. Apartment, resale and rental demand is supported by universities, employment hubs and public transport connections. Great Homes can use Jadavpur as a high-volume location node.

name: Dhakuria
tagline: A mature south Kolkata residential market connecting Gariahat, Jadavpur and Lake Gardens.
description: Dhakuria sits between several established south Kolkata neighbourhoods and benefits from strong rail, road and local-commerce connectivity. The area offers a mix of apartments, older houses and redevelopment opportunities with access to schools, healthcare and retail. It works well as an independent residential discovery page.

name: Tollygunge
tagline: A well-established south Kolkata residential district with strong metro and road connectivity.
description: Tollygunge is a major south Kolkata residential area supported by the metro, established local markets, schools and everyday services. Housing ranges from older apartment stock to newer developments and resale homes. Its access to central and southern corridors makes it an important buyer and rental market.

name: Garia
tagline: A major southern residential corridor with broad apartment supply and expanding suburban connectivity.
description: Garia is a large southern residential market with strong metro and road connectivity, extensive apartment development and access to established local retail. It serves a wide range of buyers, from value-conscious end users to families seeking larger homes. Great Homes can treat Garia as a major south Kolkata discovery market.

name: Kasba
tagline: A strategically placed south-east Kolkata residential corridor near EM Bypass and major employment hubs.
description: Kasba offers a blend of established housing, newer apartment development, local commerce and direct access to the EM Bypass corridor. Its location connects south Kolkata to eastern business and healthcare districts, supporting both end-user and rental demand. It is a useful bridge between traditional south Kolkata and the eastern growth belt.

name: EM Bypass
tagline: Kolkata's major eastern arterial lined by residential projects, hospitals, retail and business destinations.
description: The Eastern Metropolitan Bypass is one of Kolkata's most important growth corridors, connecting south-east Kolkata with Salt Lake and the eastern metropolitan belt. Large residential projects, hospitals, shopping centres, hotels and office destinations have made the corridor a key real-estate market. Great Homes can use EM Bypass as a high-intent location page alongside the neighbourhoods it connects.

name: Anandapur
tagline: A high-growth eastern residential belt close to EM Bypass, hospitals and major mixed-use developments.
description: Anandapur sits just off the EM Bypass and is known for new residential development, healthcare infrastructure and improving connectivity. The market includes large apartment projects alongside older settlements and institutional uses. Its location makes it relevant for buyers seeking eastern access without moving deep into New Town.

name: Mukundapur
tagline: A growing south-eastern residential district near hospitals, EM Bypass and new apartment developments.
description: Mukundapur is a prominent residential and healthcare-adjacent market in south-east Kolkata. It benefits from proximity to the EM Bypass, major hospitals, educational institutions and newer housing projects. Great Homes can position it as an emerging residential location with strong end-user relevance.

name: East Kolkata
tagline: A broad eastern growth belt connecting established Kolkata with Salt Lake, EM Bypass and New Town.
description: East Kolkata covers a diverse set of residential, commercial and institutional locations along the city's expanding eastern edge. The belt includes established neighbourhoods, wetlands, planned developments and major arterial corridors. Great Homes can use it as a regional discovery layer supporting location pages for Chingrighata, Science City, Metropolitan and nearby markets.

name: Topsia
tagline: A central-eastern mixed-use market with rapid residential redevelopment and access to EM Bypass.
description: Topsia is a dense mixed-use district between central Kolkata and the eastern arterial network. Residential redevelopment has accelerated alongside local commerce and improved connectivity to EM Bypass and Park Circus. The locality is relevant to both apartment resale and new residential supply.

name: Tangra
tagline: A centrally placed eastern neighbourhood transitioning from traditional uses to mixed-use residential development.
description: Tangra is a well-known eastern Kolkata district with a distinctive local identity and increasing residential redevelopment. It connects efficiently with Topsia, Park Circus, central Kolkata and the EM Bypass side of the city. Great Homes can cover it as an evolving mixed-use and residential market.

name: Behala
tagline: A large south-west Kolkata residential market with deep local infrastructure and broad housing choice.
description: Behala is one of south-west Kolkata's largest residential areas, extending across established neighbourhoods, markets, schools and transport corridors. The housing market ranges from older homes and apartments to newer projects and redevelopment. Its scale makes it an important high-volume residential search node.

name: Thakurpukur
tagline: A south-west Kolkata growth corridor with improving connectivity and expanding residential development.
description: Thakurpukur sits beyond central Behala along the Diamond Harbour Road corridor and has seen continued residential growth. The market includes apartment projects, established settlements, local commerce and access to education and healthcare. It is a useful location node for buyers seeking newer supply in south-west Kolkata.

name: Joka
tagline: A western-south Kolkata growth corridor with new housing, institutions and improving regional connectivity.
description: Joka is a fast-developing south-west growth corridor with large residential projects, institutional developments and access toward the southern suburbs. Its location on the Diamond Harbour Road axis makes it relevant for buyers looking for newer housing at the southern edge of the city. Great Homes can treat Joka as a major emerging locality.

name: Garden Reach
tagline: A Hooghly-side south-west district combining established communities, port-linked activity and residential demand.
description: Garden Reach is a south-west Kolkata locality with strong links to the river, industrial and port-related activity, and established residential communities. Property demand is more mixed than in premium south Kolkata, with apartments, older homes and redevelopment opportunities. It should be covered as a mature urban neighbourhood rather than a single project corridor.

name: Kidderpore
tagline: A historic western-south Kolkata locality with strong transport links and diverse housing stock.
description: Kidderpore is a long-established neighbourhood near the river and port-side districts, with dense local commerce and a mix of older homes and apartment properties. Its position between Alipore, Garden Reach and central Kolkata gives it strong urban connectivity. Great Homes can present it as a character-rich established market.

name: Action Area I
tagline: A mature New Town residential and mixed-use zone with established project clusters.
description: Action Area I is one of New Town's earliest developed residential planning areas, with apartment communities, local markets, parks and mixed-use destinations. It has established infrastructure and is well suited to project, resale and rental discovery.

name: Action Area IA
tagline: A well-developed residential pocket within the northern portion of Action Area I.
description: Action Area IA contains established residential blocks and neighbourhood amenities within New Town's first planning area. The location benefits from planned roads, green spaces and access to the larger Action Area I ecosystem.

name: Action Area IB
tagline: An established residential pocket with apartment communities and local amenities.
description: Action Area IB forms part of New Town's established early residential fabric, with housing, community facilities and access to major internal roads. It is useful as a more granular project location beneath New Town.

name: Action Area IC
tagline: A mixed residential zone with community facilities and convenient New Town access.
description: Action Area IC is a developed New Town pocket with residential blocks, markets and civic amenities. Its location provides good access toward central New Town and neighbouring action areas.

name: Action Area ID
tagline: A central-west New Town pocket linked to civic, commercial and residential destinations.
description: Action Area ID includes important New Town administrative and civic functions alongside nearby residential development. Its position within the planned network gives residents access to the CBD and surrounding residential districts.

name: Action Area II
tagline: A major New Town growth zone with large residential developments and expanding amenities.
description: Action Area II is a core development zone of New Town with extensive residential growth and a growing network of community amenities. It includes multiple internal sectors and is a high-priority project discovery market for Great Homes.

name: Action Area IIA
tagline: A residential sub-zone of Action Area II with newer project-led development.
description: Action Area IIA is part of the broad Action Area II residential belt, with emerging housing clusters and planned roads. It is suitable for project and configuration-based location filtering.

name: Action Area IIB
tagline: A growing residential sub-zone with newer housing and local market infrastructure.
description: Action Area IIB sits within New Town's eastern development belt and includes expanding residential communities and supporting local infrastructure. Great Homes can use it for precise project discovery beneath Action Area II.

name: Action Area IIC
tagline: A project-rich residential pocket with active development and improving neighbourhood amenities.
description: Action Area IIC is an eastern New Town residential pocket with project development, smaller housing clusters and community facilities. Its planned road network connects it with other Action Area II districts.

name: Action Area IID
tagline: A residential zone close to City Centre II and other eastern New Town destinations.
description: Action Area IID forms part of the eastern New Town residential landscape and is positioned near major retail and neighbourhood destinations. It is relevant for both new-home and resale discovery.

name: Action Area IIE
tagline: An emerging residential pocket within the broader Action Area II development belt.
description: Action Area IIE is a developing residential sub-zone with newer projects and planned urban infrastructure. It can be used as a granular location filter for projects within the Action Area II market.

name: Action Area III
tagline: A large development area combining residential projects, commercial zones and new community infrastructure.
description: Action Area III is one of New Town's three principal planning areas and contains a wide mix of residential development, community facilities and major destinations. Its scale makes it a strategic location node for Great Homes.

name: Action Area IIIA
tagline: A residential pocket within Action Area III with large housing developments.
description: Action Area IIIA is part of New Town's southern development belt and contains project-led residential growth. It benefits from the broader Action Area III road and civic infrastructure network.

name: Action Area IIIB
tagline: A growing residential district with new communities and supporting infrastructure.
description: Action Area IIIB is a developing New Town pocket with apartment communities and planned urban services. It is useful as a more precise project location under Action Area III.

name: Action Area IIIC
tagline: A developing southern New Town residential pocket with growing project supply.
description: Action Area IIIC is a newer development pocket within Action Area III, characterised by residential expansion and improving civic infrastructure. It supports location-level search for newer housing.

name: Action Area IIIE
tagline: An eastern New Town pocket with expanding housing and access to the wider township network.
description: Action Area IIIE forms part of New Town's newer eastern growth pattern. Residential projects and planned internal roads connect it with surrounding development and larger New Town destinations.

name: Action Area IIIG
tagline: A developing New Town neighbourhood with newer residential supply and open development parcels.
description: Action Area IIIG is part of the expanding Action Area III market and offers a newer residential context. It is best used for granular discovery beneath the broader New Town and Action Area III pages.

name: New Town CBD
tagline: New Town's planned central business district, surrounded by commercial and residential destinations.
description: The New Town CBD is positioned at the centre of the planned city and serves major administrative, commercial and business functions. Residential projects around the CBD benefit from proximity to employment, retail and civic infrastructure.

name: Eco Park
tagline: A landmark New Town destination surrounded by premium residential, leisure and hospitality development.
description: Eco Park anchors a major lifestyle and leisure zone of New Town and is surrounded by residential projects, hospitality and commercial development. Properties nearby benefit from strong destination value and connectivity to the main New Town road network.

name: Ecospace
tagline: A major business and IT/ITeS cluster with surrounding residential communities.
description: Ecospace is a prominent employment and commercial destination in New Town with nearby housing, retail and services. Its employment base supports rental demand and makes the surrounding residential market strategically important.

name: DLF 2 / IT Park Belt
tagline: A prominent business corridor near major IT campuses and residential growth.
description: The DLF 2 and adjoining IT-park belt forms part of New Town's employment-led commercial market and is closely linked to surrounding residential development. This location is particularly relevant for rental, executive housing and commute-driven home searches.

name: Shukhobrishti
tagline: A large residential community in New Town's Action Area III belt.
description: Shukhobrishti is a prominent residential community within the broader Action Area III market, surrounded by planned roads and local amenities. Great Homes can use it as a useful locality landmark when linking nearby projects and resale or rental listings.

name: Sector I
tagline: An established Salt Lake residential sector with mature streets and neighbourhood amenities.
description: Sector I is part of Salt Lake's original planned residential fabric, with established blocks, local markets, schools and everyday services. Its mature housing stock includes apartments, houses and resale opportunities.

name: Sector II
tagline: A mature Salt Lake sector with established residential communities and strong local connectivity.
description: Sector II combines planned residential blocks with established local commerce and civic infrastructure. Its central position within Salt Lake keeps it connected to Bidhannagar's wider employment and retail districts.

name: Sector III
tagline: A central Salt Lake sector with established homes, institutions and access to major roads.
description: Sector III is a mature residential district within Salt Lake, supported by local amenities and convenient road access. The property market includes older homes, apartments and resale opportunities.

name: Sector IV
tagline: A well-established residential sector with mature infrastructure and local commercial access.
description: Sector IV forms part of the established Salt Lake residential grid and benefits from planned streets and proximity to key neighbourhood services. It is relevant for family housing, resale and rental searches.

name: Sector V
tagline: Kolkata's major IT and business district with strong rental and residential spillover demand.
description: Sector V is Bidhannagar's principal technology and business district, surrounded by transport links, offices, retail and supporting services. Its employment concentration creates strong demand for nearby rental housing and residential communities.

name: Karunamoyee
tagline: A major Salt Lake transit and residential node around a high-activity local corridor.
description: Karunamoyee is a well-known Salt Lake location with strong public transport, retail and residential access. It connects the residential township with Sector V and other parts of Bidhannagar.

name: City Centre Salt Lake
tagline: A major retail, lifestyle and transit destination within the established Salt Lake township.
description: City Centre is a prominent Salt Lake retail and lifestyle destination surrounded by established residential sectors. Homes nearby benefit from strong access to shopping, food, entertainment and transport.

name: College More
tagline: A well-connected Salt Lake junction linking residential sectors with major institutional and office corridors.
description: College More is an important junction within the Bidhannagar urban network, supporting access between Salt Lake, Sector V and adjoining residential districts. It is relevant as a high-connectivity location reference for property searches.

name: Central Park
tagline: A green and established residential zone around Salt Lake's major open-space district.
description: The Central Park area is surrounded by established Salt Lake housing and civic amenities and offers strong everyday connectivity. It is a useful micro-location marker for residential discovery.

name: Chinar Park
tagline: A busy airport-side residential and retail junction linking Rajarhat, New Town and VIP Road.
description: Chinar Park is one of the most recognisable junctions in the Rajarhat-VIP Road corridor, surrounded by apartments, retail and daily services. Its connectivity supports both owner-occupied and rental housing demand.

name: Kaikhali
tagline: An established airport-side locality with strong road access and mixed housing supply.
description: Kaikhali is a well-connected residential and commercial pocket near the airport corridor and major roads. The market includes apartments, local housing and rental demand driven by airport and city-wide connectivity.

name: Hatiara
tagline: A long-established Rajarhat locality now integrated into a fast-changing eastern growth belt.
description: Hatiara combines older settlement patterns with newer residential and road development. Its location between mature local communities and the New Town growth corridor makes it useful for value-oriented property searches.

name: Rajarhat Chowmatha
tagline: A major Rajarhat junction serving local commerce, transport and surrounding residential development.
description: Rajarhat Chowmatha is an important local movement and market node within the broader Rajarhat belt. Surrounding housing includes established homes and newer apartment development with access toward New Town and the airport-side corridor.

name: Rekjuani
tagline: A fast-changing eastern fringe with housing growth and direct links toward New Town.
description: Rekjuani sits close to the newer New Town expansion and has seen residential development alongside improving road connectivity. It can serve as a local search node for newer housing supply.

name: Narayanpur
tagline: An airport-side residential locality with established communities and broad road connectivity.
description: Narayanpur is a northern Rajarhat locality supported by nearby arterial roads, local markets and access toward the airport corridor. Housing is a mix of apartments and established residential communities.

name: Kamarbandhi
tagline: A local Rajarhat residential pocket close to expanding urban infrastructure.
description: Kamarbandhi retains a local residential character while benefiting from the wider growth of Rajarhat and New Town. It is suited to granular neighbourhood-level search below the Rajarhat node.

name: Kalipark
tagline: A residential pocket in the growing eastern Rajarhat development corridor.
description: Kalipark sits within the broader Rajarhat growth belt and is increasingly linked to planned housing and surrounding urban infrastructure. Great Homes can use it to refine searches around projects in this part of the corridor.

name: Teghoria
tagline: A dense north-eastern Kolkata locality with strong airport and VIP Road connectivity.
description: Teghoria sits near the airport approach and is well linked to Rajarhat, New Town and northern Kolkata. The market combines apartments, independent homes and active local commerce.

name: Bablatala
tagline: A mixed residential pocket connecting older settlement areas with New Town's eastern growth.
description: Bablatala sits within the Rajarhat-New Town transition belt and combines established residential patterns with newer apartment development. It is relevant to buyers seeking connectivity to both New Town and the airport-side corridor.

name: Dum Dum Cantonment
tagline: A well-established northern neighbourhood with rail, metro and airport-side connectivity.
description: Dum Dum Cantonment is a mature residential district with established communities and strong transport connections. It offers a mix of apartments, older homes and family-oriented housing close to the airport-side corridor.

name: Nagerbazar
tagline: A busy northern Kolkata residential and retail junction on the Jessore Road corridor.
description: Nagerbazar is a high-activity urban junction surrounded by apartments, retail and everyday services. Its position between Dum Dum, Lake Town and the airport corridor makes it a practical residential search node.

name: Motijheel
tagline: An established Dum Dum residential pocket with schools, local commerce and transport access.
description: Motijheel offers mature residential infrastructure and convenient access to the wider Dum Dum and airport-side road network. The market includes older apartments and houses with active resale demand.

name: Dum Dum Park
tagline: A popular north-eastern Kolkata neighbourhood with established apartment communities.
description: Dum Dum Park is a mature residential locality positioned close to Lake Town and the airport corridor. It benefits from established retail, schools and road connectivity and is suitable for apartment and resale discovery.

name: Jessore Road Corridor
tagline: A major northern corridor linking Kolkata with the airport and suburban markets.
description: The Jessore Road corridor is a key north-eastern transport spine with residential, retail and commercial uses. Property demand is supported by airport access, road connectivity and nearby established neighbourhoods.

name: VIP Road
tagline: A high-connectivity eastern road corridor linking Kolkata, the airport and Rajarhat-New Town.
description: VIP Road is a major transport corridor lined by residential buildings, retail and service businesses. Nearby properties benefit from direct access to the airport, Salt Lake and Rajarhat-New Town.

name: Bangur Avenue
tagline: An established residential enclave with strong local markets and access to VIP Road.
description: Bangur Avenue is a mature north-eastern residential pocket with established apartments, local commerce and strong connections to Lake Town and Salt Lake. It is useful for end-user and resale searches.

name: Teghoria
tagline: A well-connected airport-side residential market with dense apartment development.
description: The Teghoria side of the Baguiati corridor benefits from proximity to the airport, VIP Road and Rajarhat. Apartments and rental homes are supported by commuters, professionals and established local demand.

name: Kestopur Canal Belt
tagline: A dense residential belt defined by local communities, apartment development and canal-side geography.
description: The Kestopur canal-side belt connects older settlements with newer apartment development toward Salt Lake and New Town. Property searches here are often driven by value, connectivity and access to employment hubs.

name: Prafulla Kanan
tagline: A popular residential pocket near Salt Lake, Kestopur and major eastern roads.
description: Prafulla Kanan is an established residential area with convenient access to Salt Lake and the airport-side eastern road network. The housing market is predominantly apartment-led with steady family and rental demand.

name: Shyambazar
tagline: A historic north Kolkata junction surrounded by established housing, markets and transport links.
description: Shyambazar is a major north Kolkata urban node with strong public transport, local commerce and long-established residential streets. Its central-north position gives it convenient access to surrounding heritage and residential neighbourhoods.

name: Hatibagan
tagline: A historic market and residential district in the heart of north Kolkata.
description: Hatibagan combines traditional retail, local markets and established housing in a highly connected north Kolkata setting. Apartments, older homes and redevelopment opportunities form the area's diverse property stock.

name: Shobhabazar
tagline: A heritage-rich north Kolkata neighbourhood with established residential communities.
description: Shobhabazar is known for its historic streets, traditional homes and established urban community. Property demand includes resale apartments, heritage homes and selective redevelopment opportunities.

name: Sovabazar
tagline: A traditional north Kolkata district with heritage housing and strong central connectivity.
description: Sovabazar is a long-established neighbourhood with historic residential fabric and strong access to north and central Kolkata. The market mixes older homes, apartments and redevelopment sites.

name: Bagbazar
tagline: A Hooghly-side north Kolkata neighbourhood with strong heritage and residential identity.
description: Bagbazar lies along the western edge of north Kolkata and combines older residential streets with cultural and river-adjacent landmarks. Housing stock includes traditional homes and newer apartment opportunities.

name: Kumartuli
tagline: A distinctive heritage neighbourhood known for traditional craft communities and historic streets.
description: Kumartuli is one of north Kolkata's best-known traditional neighbourhoods, with a strong cultural identity and historic built fabric. Residential property here is closely tied to the character of the locality and redevelopment constraints.

name: Jorasanko
tagline: A historic cultural district with heritage homes and central-north Kolkata connectivity.
description: Jorasanko is a heritage-rich neighbourhood near central and north Kolkata, known for its historic houses and cultural institutions. Property opportunities are largely in established homes, apartments and redevelopment.

name: Chitpur
tagline: A historic northern corridor blending established residential pockets with industrial and transport activity.
description: Chitpur connects north Kolkata with the river-side and northern transport network and has a varied urban character. Property supply includes older homes, apartments and mixed-use premises.

name: Burrabazar
tagline: A dense commercial district with limited but strategically located residential opportunities.
description: Burrabazar is one of Kolkata's largest traditional commercial districts, with dense trading activity and historic mixed-use buildings. Residential demand here is closely linked to central-city employment and business access.

name: Posta
tagline: A historic trading district near the Hooghly and central Kolkata business core.
description: Posta is a dense commercial locality with strong links to Burrabazar, central Kolkata and the river-side transport network. Residential properties tend to be integrated into older mixed-use buildings.

name: Rajabazar
tagline: A centrally located north Kolkata neighbourhood with strong educational and transport connectivity.
description: Rajabazar sits close to major arterial roads and educational institutions and offers dense urban housing with active local commerce. It is relevant for value-oriented resale and rental searches.

name: Maniktala
tagline: A mature north-central residential district with markets and good road connectivity.
description: Maniktala is an established mixed residential area connecting north and central Kolkata. Housing includes apartments, older homes and redevelopment opportunities supported by strong local retail.

name: Narkeldanga
tagline: A north-central neighbourhood with established residential streets and access to major roads.
description: Narkeldanga is a dense residential and mixed-use locality east of central Kolkata. It benefits from access to Sealdah, Phoolbagan and the central city while retaining a strong local community character.

name: Phoolbagan
tagline: A well-connected north-eastern Kolkata neighbourhood near major roads and metro access.
description: Phoolbagan is a growing residential and transit node between central Kolkata and Salt Lake-side corridors. The area offers established housing with improving connectivity and access to local amenities.

name: Ultadanga
tagline: A major north-east Kolkata transport junction connecting Salt Lake, Sealdah and the airport side.
description: Ultadanga is a key transport and residential junction linking several major Kolkata corridors. Property demand is supported by strong connectivity, local markets and access to employment centres.

name: Kankurgachi
tagline: A mature north-eastern residential market with strong retail and arterial-road access.
description: Kankurgachi is an established residential and retail district east of central Kolkata, with apartments, local commerce and good road connectivity. It is a strong end-user and resale market.

name: Cossipore
tagline: A north Kolkata neighbourhood with established housing and historic industrial context.
description: Cossipore is a long-established northern locality with a mixed urban character shaped by residential communities and industrial-era development. Apartment and resale opportunities benefit from links to the northern road network.

name: Tala
tagline: A residential pocket between Cossipore and Shyambazar with mature local infrastructure.
description: Tala is part of the established north Kolkata residential belt and provides access to Cossipore, Shyambazar and nearby markets. Housing is predominantly mature apartment and family stock.

name: Belgachia
tagline: A north-central neighbourhood with metro access and established residential communities.
description: Belgachia is a mature residential locality with strong metro connectivity and access toward Dum Dum and north Kolkata. Housing includes established apartments and older homes.

name: Sinthee
tagline: A northern residential neighbourhood with access to BT Road and surrounding suburban markets.
description: Sinthee sits along the northern transport network and combines established housing with local commerce. Its connectivity makes it useful for family-home and resale discovery.

name: B. B. D. Bagh
tagline: Kolkata's core government and financial district around historic civic institutions.
description: B. B. D. Bagh is the administrative and financial heart of central Kolkata, surrounded by government offices, banks, courts and heritage buildings. Residential property is limited but strategically relevant for central-city workers and investors.

name: Esplanade
tagline: A central transport and retail district connecting the CBD with major city corridors.
description: Esplanade is a major central Kolkata transport, retail and public-space node close to office districts and the Maidan. Residential opportunities are mostly in adjacent established neighbourhoods.

name: Bowbazar
tagline: A traditional central Kolkata neighbourhood blending residential streets, markets and institutions.
description: Bowbazar is a long-established central locality close to College Street, Sealdah and the CBD. Its property market includes apartments, older homes and mixed-use buildings.

name: College Street
tagline: A landmark education, book and retail district with strong central-city connectivity.
description: College Street is a major educational and cultural corridor in central Kolkata with historic institutions and dense local commerce. Residential demand is largely driven by students, professionals and proximity to central employment.

name: Sealdah
tagline: A major rail and transport hub surrounded by dense residential and commercial neighbourhoods.
description: Sealdah is one of Kolkata's principal transportation nodes, creating strong commuter-oriented rental and residential demand in surrounding areas. The market includes apartments, older buildings and mixed-use properties.

name: Taltala
tagline: A dense central Kolkata neighbourhood close to Park Street and major employment districts.
description: Taltala is an established central locality with access to Park Street, Esplanade and the CBD. Housing is predominantly apartment and mixed-use stock suited to centrally located living.

name: Entally
tagline: A central-south neighbourhood with strong access to hospitals, transport and local markets.
description: Entally is positioned between central Kolkata and the eastern residential belt and is supported by hospitals, local commerce and major roads. Residential stock includes older homes, apartments and redevelopment sites.

name: Moulali
tagline: A central Kolkata junction linking Sealdah, Park Street and eastern neighbourhoods.
description: Moulali is a strategic urban junction with quick access to multiple central and eastern corridors. Housing is mixed with strong rental relevance due to its commuting advantages.

name: New Market
tagline: A landmark central retail district surrounded by offices, hotels and established residential areas.
description: New Market is a major central Kolkata retail destination close to Park Street and Esplanade. Properties nearby benefit from strong city-centre accessibility and proximity to employment and lifestyle amenities.

name: Camac Street
tagline: A premium office and retail corridor in the Park Street business belt.
description: Camac Street forms part of central Kolkata's premium office and commercial district, surrounded by retail, hospitality and established residential neighbourhoods. Nearby housing benefits from a short commute to major central employment zones.

name: Theatre Road
tagline: A centrally placed premium corridor with offices, apartments and lifestyle destinations.
description: The Theatre Road area sits within the central-south premium business and residential belt. It offers access to Park Street, Ballygunge and major arterial roads and is relevant for higher-end city-centre residences.

name: Chowringhee
tagline: A landmark central Kolkata corridor connecting the Maidan, CBD and premium commercial areas.
description: Chowringhee is a major city-centre address lined by offices, hotels, cultural landmarks and access to the Maidan. Residential demand is often linked to premium central-city access and nearby employment.

name: Gariahat Road
tagline: A busy south Kolkata residential-retail corridor with strong everyday convenience.
description: Gariahat Road anchors one of south Kolkata's most active residential and retail markets. Apartments and established homes benefit from dense commerce, schools and access to Ballygunge and Dhakuria.

name: Hindustan Park
tagline: A premium residential pocket near Gariahat with leafy streets and established homes.
description: Hindustan Park is a sought-after south Kolkata residential pocket close to Gariahat's retail and cultural infrastructure. The housing market includes established residences, renovated homes and premium apartments.

name: Ballygunge Place
tagline: A prime residential pocket with mature apartment communities and premium housing stock.
description: Ballygunge Place is a well-established residential pocket within the larger Ballygunge market. It benefits from proximity to schools, healthcare, retail and the city's central business districts.

name: Ballygunge Circular Road
tagline: A premium south Kolkata corridor connecting Ballygunge with Alipore and central districts.
description: Ballygunge Circular Road is a major premium residential and institutional corridor with established apartments, independent homes and easy access to Alipore and Park Street. It remains a high-value address.

name: Deshapriya Park
tagline: A mature south Kolkata residential pocket near Rashbehari and Gariahat.
description: Deshapriya Park is surrounded by established apartment communities, retail streets and everyday amenities. Its location gives residents easy access to Gariahat, Ballygunge and south Kolkata's major roads.

name: Dhakuria Lake
tagline: A residential pocket around a prominent south Kolkata green and recreational zone.
description: The Dhakuria Lake side of the area combines mature apartments with access to open space, local markets and transport links. It is useful for family-oriented residential searches with strong neighbourhood identity.

name: Jodhpur Park
tagline: A well-established south Kolkata residential enclave with parks, schools and family housing.
description: Jodhpur Park is a mature residential neighbourhood known for established homes, apartment communities and local amenities. Its position near Jadavpur, Dhakuria and Gariahat supports strong end-user demand.

name: Lake Gardens
tagline: A green, well-connected residential pocket between Tollygunge and south Kolkata's established districts.
description: Lake Gardens is a mature residential neighbourhood with apartments, houses and everyday amenities, positioned close to Tollygunge and Dhakuria. Connectivity to metro and major roads supports both owner-occupied and rental demand.

name: Golf Green
tagline: An established south Kolkata residential area with open spaces and apartment communities.
description: Golf Green is a well-established residential district south of Tollygunge with a strong family-housing profile. The area benefits from access to metro, roads, schools and local retail.

name: Rashbehari Avenue
tagline: A major south Kolkata corridor linking Ballygunge, Gariahat and Tollygunge-side markets.
description: Rashbehari Avenue is one of south Kolkata's principal commercial and residential roads, lined with established neighbourhoods and local retail. Nearby housing benefits from strong public transport and everyday convenience.

name: Sarat Bose Road
tagline: A major south Kolkata corridor with established apartments, retail and healthcare access.
description: Sarat Bose Road connects several premium south Kolkata neighbourhoods and supports a mature apartment market. Its central position provides direct access to Ballygunge, Bhowanipore and Alipore.

name: Hazra
tagline: A major south Kolkata junction surrounded by established residential and commercial streets.
description: Hazra is a well-connected south Kolkata market at the meeting point of several established residential corridors. Apartments and resale properties benefit from strong transport, retail and healthcare access.

name: Rashbehari
tagline: A central-south neighbourhood anchored by one of Kolkata's best-known retail corridors.
description: The Rashbehari area combines dense local retail, established apartment communities and strong connectivity to Ballygunge and Tollygunge. It is relevant for practical city living and resale searches.

name: Alipore Road
tagline: A premium south Kolkata corridor with institutional landmarks and established housing.
description: Alipore Road is one of the city's most established premium residential addresses, with large properties, apartment buildings and civic destinations nearby. Its position provides convenient access to central Kolkata and New Alipore.

name: New Alipore Block A
tagline: A planned residential pocket with broad streets, apartments and established local amenities.
description: Block A is part of New Alipore's planned residential fabric and offers mature housing with access to markets, schools and transport. It is useful for precise project and resale location tagging.

name: New Alipore Block C
tagline: A mature residential block with established apartments and local convenience.
description: Block C forms part of New Alipore's established housing network with easy access to local amenities and major roads. Properties here are relevant for resale and family-home searches.

name: Tollygunge Metro
tagline: A transit-oriented south Kolkata pocket centred on metro and daily retail access.
description: The Tollygunge Metro area benefits from strong public transport, local retail and established residential streets. It is a practical location marker for buyers and tenants prioritising commute efficiency.

name: Rabindra Sarobar
tagline: A green and recreational district with premium residential appeal and excellent connectivity.
description: Rabindra Sarobar is a prominent open-space and recreational destination surrounded by established south Kolkata residential neighbourhoods. Properties nearby benefit from greenery, amenities and access to metro and central corridors.

name: Jadavpur 8B
tagline: A high-activity Jadavpur neighbourhood near education, retail and transport corridors.
description: The 8B area is a major Jadavpur movement and retail node surrounded by apartment housing, educational uses and daily services. It is highly relevant for rental and end-user searches.

name: Central Jadavpur
tagline: A mature residential pocket around Jadavpur's education and local-market ecosystem.
description: Central Jadavpur offers established homes, apartments and strong everyday amenities with access to universities and public transport. Its housing demand is supported by students, families and professionals.

name: Baghajatin
tagline: A south Kolkata residential market with rail connectivity and broad local housing stock.
description: Baghajatin is a mature residential locality south of Jadavpur with apartments, houses and local markets. The area is supported by rail and road connectivity and is relevant to mid-market buyers and renters.

name: Santoshpur
tagline: A large south-east residential district with established housing and local amenities.
description: Santoshpur combines mature apartment communities with established neighbourhoods and access toward EM Bypass and Jadavpur. It has broad family-oriented housing demand and steady resale activity.

name: Bikramgarh
tagline: A compact south Kolkata residential pocket near Tollygunge and Jadavpur corridors.
description: Bikramgarh is an established local residential area with convenient access to Tollygunge, Jadavpur and major roads. It is suited to granular resale and rental location tagging.

name: Baghajatin Park
tagline: A well-connected southern residential pocket with established family housing.
description: Baghajatin Park is part of the wider southern residential market and benefits from access to rail, local retail and major roads. Housing includes apartments and independent homes.

name: Garia Station
tagline: A transit-led residential hub with strong local retail and apartment supply.
description: Garia Station anchors a busy southern residential and commercial zone with metro, rail and road connectivity. Nearby housing serves a broad buyer base and strong rental demand.

name: Baishnabghata
tagline: A southern residential locality with access to Garia, EM Bypass and newer developments.
description: Baishnabghata is a growing residential pocket between established south Kolkata and the eastern growth belt. The area includes apartments and local housing with improving access to key roads.

name: Patuli
tagline: A planned southern residential neighbourhood with established housing and open-space access.
description: Patuli is a planned residential area with apartment communities, local markets and access to lakes and open spaces. It is a strong family-oriented market within the southern corridor.

name: Kamalgazi
tagline: A fast-growing southern gateway linking Garia with Rajpur-Sonarpur and newer housing.
description: Kamalgazi is an important southern growth node with newer apartment development, road connectivity and access toward the wider suburban market. Great Homes can use it as an emerging location for project-led supply.

name: Rajpur
tagline: A southern growth corridor with larger homes, apartments and expanding infrastructure.
description: Rajpur lies beyond the core Garia market and offers a mix of established communities, newer apartment projects and larger residential formats. It is relevant for buyers seeking more space while remaining connected to Kolkata.

name: Sonarpur
tagline: A major southern suburban market with broad residential supply and rail connectivity.
description: Sonarpur is a major southern suburban node with substantial residential development and rail access. The market includes apartments, independent homes and newer township-style projects.

name: Ruby Junction
tagline: A major eastern junction surrounded by hospitals, offices, retail and residential projects.
description: Ruby Junction is one of EM Bypass's most important mixed-use nodes, surrounded by healthcare, retail and residential development. Nearby projects benefit from high road visibility and strong cross-city connectivity.

name: Science City
tagline: A central-eastern landmark district with access to EM Bypass and major city destinations.
description: The Science City area sits near the EM Bypass and major central-east connectors and has a mix of institutional, hospitality and residential uses nearby. Its strategic position makes it useful for city-wide property discovery.

name: Chingrighata
tagline: A strategic eastern junction linking Kolkata, Salt Lake and EM Bypass.
description: Chingrighata is an important movement corridor between central Kolkata, Salt Lake and EM Bypass-side neighbourhoods. Residential demand is supported by its commuting advantages and proximity to major employment zones.

name: Metropolitan
tagline: A south-eastern Kolkata corridor with apartments, local commerce and access to EM Bypass.
description: Metropolitan is a mixed residential and commercial corridor between Topsia and EM Bypass. It offers established housing and direct road access to central and south-east Kolkata.

name: East Kolkata Township
tagline: A modern eastern residential and institutional belt near EM Bypass.
description: East Kolkata Township is a growing mixed-use residential corridor with newer projects, institutional uses and proximity to major hospitals and EM Bypass. It is suited to modern apartment-led housing searches.

name: Picnic Garden
tagline: A dense south-eastern residential locality close to Topsia, EM Bypass and Park Circus.
description: Picnic Garden is a well-established residential pocket with local commerce and strong access to surrounding eastern corridors. Housing is predominantly apartment and mixed-use stock.

name: Tiljala
tagline: A centrally located south-eastern neighbourhood with redevelopment and apartment demand.
description: Tiljala sits close to Park Circus, Topsia and major central-east roads and has an evolving residential landscape. Newer apartments and redevelopment opportunities sit alongside established communities.

name: Sakher Bazar
tagline: A major Behala retail and transit node surrounded by established residential neighbourhoods.
description: Sakher Bazar is one of Behala's best-known local commercial and transport centres, surrounded by apartments, houses and everyday services. It is an important micro-location for resale and rental searches.

name: Barisha
tagline: A historic south-west Kolkata residential area with established communities and local markets.
description: Barisha is a long-established residential district with traditional homes, apartments and local commerce. Its proximity to Behala, Thakurpukur and major roads supports steady family-oriented housing demand.

name: Parnasree Pally
tagline: A residential pocket with established apartments and local neighbourhood amenities.
description: Parnasree Pally is a mature south-west residential locality with apartments, schools, markets and everyday services. It is relevant for family housing and resale-led discovery.

name: Haridevpur
tagline: A south Kolkata residential market with strong local commerce and access toward Tollygunge.
description: Haridevpur sits between Behala and Tollygunge-side corridors and offers established apartments, houses and local retail. Its position supports practical commuter-oriented housing searches.

name: Thakurpukur Bazar
tagline: A busy south-west local market surrounded by expanding residential development.
description: Thakurpukur Bazar is a key local-commerce node along the Diamond Harbour Road corridor. The surrounding residential market includes apartments, older homes and newer development.

name: Diamond Park
tagline: An emerging south-west residential zone with newer housing and institutional development.
description: Diamond Park sits within Joka's fast-growing housing corridor and benefits from newer project supply and road connectivity. It is useful for project-level discovery in the southern growth market.

name: Pailan
tagline: A south-west suburban growth zone with larger land parcels and expanding housing.
description: Pailan is part of the growing Joka-south-west corridor and offers a mix of residential development, larger plots and local communities. It is suited to buyers seeking newer or more spacious housing formats.

name: Khidderpore Docklands
tagline: A river-side western Kolkata belt shaped by port-linked activity and established communities.
description: The Khidderpore docklands area is closely tied to the port and Hooghly-side geography and includes dense established residential pockets. Housing demand is driven by affordability, employment access and local community networks.

name: Watgunge
tagline: A south-west river-side neighbourhood with established housing and port-side connectivity.
description: Watgunge is a mature locality between central-west Kolkata and Garden Reach, with dense residential and mixed-use development. It benefits from access to the port-side employment network and major roads.

name: Metiabruz
tagline: A large south-west locality with dense residential communities and strong local markets.
description: Metiabruz is a substantial south-west Kolkata market with established communities, local commerce and port-side connectivity. The property market is predominantly established housing and apartment stock.
